fields.summary: TC-704-01: New Legs Enriched With Flight Information When Involuntary Change Introduces New Leg

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-704

Precondition: An involuntary Save and Replace introduces a new leg into the trip that did not exist in the previous version. Flight information (origin, destination, departure/arrival times, flight number) must be populated on the new leg.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Trigger an involuntary Save and Replace that adds a new leg to an existing trip (leg not present in previous version V0)
V0: Trip with 1 leg (DAL->HOU). V1: Trip with 2 legs (DAL->AUS, AUS->HOU). New leg: AUS->HOU, legType=Flying, changeType=INVOL
V1 is created with the new leg AUS->HOU included in the trip payload
Trigger the COA enrichment Lambda to process V1 containing the new leg
V1 trip payload with new leg AUS->HOU lacking full flight detail enrichment
Enrichment Lambda is invoked and processes the new leg
Verify the enrichment Lambda fetches and populates flight information for the new leg from the flight data source
New leg: AUS->HOU, flight number, scheduled dep/arr times, block-out/block-in, distance
Lambda populates flightNumber, origin, destination, depDateTimeUTC, arrDateTimeUTC, blockOut, blockIn, and distance on the new leg
Verify the enriched new leg is persisted in DynamoDB with all flight information fields populated
DynamoDB coatable record for the trip after enrichment
DynamoDB record shows all flight information fields are non-null on the new leg
Verify the COA Search App displays the enriched flight information for the new leg
COA Search App queried for the updated trip
COA Search App shows new leg with full flight details including origin, destination, departure/arrival times and flight number
